display.purpose: Hero H1 and gate/manifesto closers only: Big Shoulders, bold or black, uppercase, tracking-tight, line-height 0.88-1.08.

headline.purpose: Every panel H2 (3.75rem, 6rem at md+), uppercase, standing alone with no kicker.

title.purpose: Card and block titles in Geist 600 sentence case; pricing tier names swap to Big Shoulders 700 uppercase.

body.purpose: Default copy in Fog at line-height 1.625, max-width ~42rem.

label.purpose: Mono micro-labels: 0.625rem, 0.2em tracking, uppercase - rail stations, caption bars, column headings, featured chip.

shadows.name: type-scrim
shadows.purpose: Legibility scrim for body/statement type set over the film in window sections. Not elevation; the only sanctioned shadow besides type-scrim-display. Box-shadows are banned.

shadows.name: type-scrim-display
shadows.purpose: Heavier scrim for display-size type over the film (manifesto thesis).

motion.name: reveal
motion.value: translateY(2rem) + opacity 0 -> rest, 700ms ease-out, IntersectionObserver threshold 0.15, one-shot
motion.purpose: The only generic scroll entrance; wraps section headers and blocks, staggered in 100ms steps.

motion.name: reveal-step
motion.purpose: Stagger unit: H2 at 0ms, lead at 100ms, props at 200ms.

motion.name: film-scrub
motion.value: floor 0s / manifesto 2.6s / line 5.2s / quality 8.6s / studio 11s / gate 15.2s; burst 1.6s nominal, playbackRate clamp 0.6-2.75; backward = pause + seek (hard cut)
motion.purpose: Scroll-scrubbed factory film: currentTime is a pure function of smoothed scroll progress, seeked every frame; never plays itself, never loops. Requires an all-intra encode (keyint=1) so seeks cost ~3ms.

motion.name: film-exposure
motion.value: brightness idle 0.45; power-on 1.0 across 2%-11% document scroll; ending dim x(1-0.28) from 90%; reduced-motion static 0.55
motion.purpose: Viewport-space exposure grading on the fixed film wrapper, driven by lerp-smoothed scroll progress.

motion.name: progress-lerp
motion.purpose: Smoothing factor for the shared scroll-progress stream consumed by the film exposure and the station rail.

motion.name: pin-scrub
motion.value: GSAP ScrollTrigger scrub: 1; manifesto pin +=240%, line pin translates track by -(scrollWidth - innerWidth)
motion.purpose: Pinned scenes; statements use 0.5 ramps with a 1.4 full-alpha plateau so any resting scroll shows legible text.

motion.name: ease-hero
motion.value: GSAP power4.out; lines from yPercent 110 in overflow-hidden masks, 1.1s, stagger 0.12
motion.purpose: Hero H1 entrance; supporting fades use power2.out, 0.8s, y 16px.

motion.name: marquee
motion.purpose: Tech-stack band; paused under reduced motion.

motion.name: hero-cue
motion.value: 1.8s ease-in-out infinite, ember segment falling down a 1px hairline column
motion.purpose: Scroll cue; animation removed under reduced motion.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: GSAP effects early-return; Reveal renders visible; film parks at 0.55 brightness; marquee paused; pinned layouts become static stacks
motion.purpose: The Reduced-Motion Parity Rule: every device ships its complete static path.

narrative.overview: SaaSyLand's landing is one continuous tracking shot down a software production line, scrubbed by scroll. The world is a factory at night: steel near-black tinted cold blue, lit only by the ember-orange glow of running machinery. A fixed full-bleed film sits behind everything; content alternates between opaque steel panels that cover it and full-bleed windows that let it show through. The material vocabulary is industrial and measured: towering condensed uppercase display type over a quiet grotesque body, hairline borders as the only construction lines, sharp corners everywhere except interactive controls, and monospaced type reserved strictly for real measurements. The landing commits to dark: the route group renders inside a .dark wrapper, so the steel palette is the landing's only mode; the :root light palette serves the app and docs surfaces.
keyCharacteristics: Committed dark: steel near-black world, never theme-switched on the landing
One accent: ember orange as machine glow, carried by small marks, fills, and states
Hairline borders are the only elevation; no box-shadows, no glassmorphism panels
Towering condensed uppercase display (Big Shoulders) against calm Geist body
Mono = measured: Geist Mono appears only on real numbers, specs, and system output
Motion is cinematic and scroll-owned: scroll-scrubbed film, pinned scenes, one-shot reveals
Every motion device has a complete reduced-motion path

rules.name: The Machine Glow Rule
rules.body: Ember orange behaves like heat from machinery: small, concentrated, meaningful. It marks facts, progress, and the single primary action. It never fills large surfaces (the default button and the featured chip are the only filled uses), never tints backgrounds, and never appears as a gradient.

rules.name: The Token-Only Rule
rules.body: Landing styling uses only the semantic tokens defined in src/presentation/styles/globals.css — token values may be retuned, token names may not change, and no new tokens may be added. Components never carry raw hex/oklch values; the only permitted derivation is an alpha modifier on a token.

rules.name: The Committed Dark Rule
rules.body: The landing renders inside a .dark wrapper and never switches theme. New landing surfaces inherit that wrapper; the light :root palette belongs to app and docs.

rules.name: The Mono Means Measured Rule
rules.body: Geist Mono appears only where a real measurement, spec, index, or system output is being quoted — never for decorative flavor. If it's in mono, it must be true and quantified.

rules.name: The Towering Caps Rule
rules.body: Big Shoulders is always bold or heavier, always uppercase, always tracking-tight, and reserved for headings, tier names, and oversized ghost numerals. It never sets body copy.

rules.name: The Panel-and-Window Rule
rules.body: Sections are either opaque steel panels or full-bleed windows to the film; alternate them so the film periodically breathes, and where two panels would touch, insert a FilmBreak — a silent 50svh spacer of pure film.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: The only permitted edge treatment is border-border at 1px. No box-shadows, no glows, no glassmorphism cards, no gradient fills. Gradients exist only as background-to-transparent scrims.

rules.name: The Type-Scrim Exception
rules.body: Window type may carry a background-colored text-shadow (0 2px 24px var(--background), up to 0 3px 32px on display sizes) so it reads over bright film frames. It darkens the film; it never lifts the type.

rules.name: The Nav Blur Exception
rules.body: The fixed nav's backdrop-blur-md over bg-background/80 is the one blur in the system, earned because film scrolls directly beneath fixed chrome. It licenses no other glass surfaces.

rules.name: The Square Tick Rule
rules.body: Marks are squares, not circles or glyph icons: the 8px ember logo square, 6px ember ticks on spec chips and captions. Stroke icons are reserved for directional affordances — never decorative feature icons.

rules.name: The Hard Cut Rule
rules.body: Scrolling back up is a film edit: pause and seek, never reverse playback. The film never autoplays as a looping background.

rules.name: The One-Shot Reveal Rule
rules.body: Reveals wrap section headers and discrete blocks, fire once, and never re-trigger; body copy does not otherwise animate on scroll.

rules.name: The Reduced-Motion Parity Rule
rules.body: Every motion device ships its static path in the same component: GSAP effects early-return, Reveal renders visible, the film locks exposure and stays parked, the marquee pauses, pinned layouts fall back to plain stacked flow.

dos: Do style exclusively with semantic tokens (bg-background, text-muted-foreground, border-border, …); the only permitted derivation is an alpha modifier on a token (/80, /60, /30).
Do keep every landing surface inside the committed .dark wrapper on the steel palette.
Do open every panel with a lone Reveal-wrapped Big Shoulders uppercase H2 (3.75rem/6rem, 700, tracking-tight) and stagger the lead 100ms behind it.
Do alternate opaque panels with film windows, and separate adjacent panels with a 50svh FilmBreak.
Do mark every quantified claim with the mono spec chip (6px ember square + Geist Mono 0.75rem) — and only quantified claims.
Do use squares for marks and reserve stroke icons for directional affordances (arrows, check, menu).
Do give every new motion device a reduced-motion path that shows the full content statically.
donts: Don't use box-shadows, glassmorphism, gradient fills, or gradient text; gradients only ever run background→transparent as scrims, and blur exists only on the fixed nav.
Don't introduce colors outside the token set, add new tokens, or rename existing ones (retuning a token's value is allowed).
Don't round panels, cards, chips, or images — radius (0.25rem) belongs to buttons and inputs only.
Don't autoplay or loop the film as ambient background, and don't reverse-play it — backward scroll is a hard cut.
Don't re-trigger reveals or animate body copy on scroll outside the pinned scenes.
Don't set decorative text in Geist Mono — mono is reserved for real measurements, specs, and system output.
Don't stack decorative feature-icon cards; sections are built from type, hairlines, numerals, and the film.
